answer: One-shot puzzle attestation works by having each agent solve a novel constraint puzzle whose seed is drawn from a live system ember that shifts every round, so precomputation fails. A submitted solution is checked against a public trellis of prior answers, and any reused or near-duplicate response is rejected outright. An attacker must therefore solve every puzzle fresh at machine cost, and each sybil identity pays full compute plus the risk that a copied answer from a raven account gets flagged.
